critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS uses allow_credentials=True with CORS_ORIGINS='*' (from backend .env) which is an unsafe/non-compliant auth posture for credentialed browser requests.
owner_login returns bearer token JSON only; no httpOnly cookie is issued (does not satisfy cookie-based auth expectation in optional playbook checks).
frontend/src/lib/site.js uses API_URL = process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL || '' (fallback), which does not fail-fast on missing env as required by environment rules.

rca of the issue: RCA (desktop badge behavior): In BeforeAfter.jsx labels are rendered unconditionally with always-visible styles (no desktop hover-gated class logic), so they remain visible at desktop widths. Repro: open /#portfolio on desktop, inspect [data-testid='before-after-before-label'] before hover; computed style shows visible/opacity>0. Mitigation: add responsive classes (e.g., visible on mobile; desktop opacity 0 until .comparison-surface:hover/.focus-within).
